title: Native wrapper identifier hygiene
objective: Make compiler-generated native and WebAssembly wrapper identifiers collision-free for ordinary typed-Python parameter and local names, with neutral same-source dynamic/native/Wasm differential and emitted-C regression coverage

oracles: neutral CPython, dynamic JavaScript, native host, and WebAssembly differential
inspectable generated C with adversarial source identifiers

handoff.summary: Native Node adapters now allocate deterministic fresh internal C identifiers against the complete set of source-derived parameter identifiers. Tagged, exact/GMP, tuple-result, resource-refresh, exact-initialization, and Float64 adapters all use the hygienic mapping. A neutral witness reproduces the Cantor status collision and additional result/item/initialization collisions, inspects native and Wasm output, and agrees across CPython, dynamic JavaScript, and compiled native execution.
risks: The complete pnpm test:native integration suite remains for the integration lane; focused native/compiler regressions, architecture checks, and strict baselib checks pass.
next_steps: Cherry-pick the hygiene commit into higher-genus and compile the fused Cantor search with its original status parameter spelling.
Run the integrated native suite and platform CI on Windows x64 and arm64 hosts.
